action.content: Write a funny song-style poem for kids about why you shouldn't eat a lot of sweets. The poem should have four sections, with each section marked with SECTION X.
action.label: context

action.content:
SECTION 1
Oh, the candy shop is calling, with a wrapper bright and sweet,
A chocolate bar, a lollipop, a treat that's hard to beat!
You grab a bag of gummy bears and stuff them in your mouth,
But wait! Your tummy starts to rumble, it's making quite a scowl!
It goes *gurgle-gurgle-gloop*, it sounds like a swampy bog,
You're dancing on your tiptoes, but you're feeling like a frog!
The sugar rush is zooming fast, you're bouncing off the wall,
But then you crash right onto the floor, and that is not so small!

SECTION 2
SECTION 2
Now look at your front teeth, they're sparkling white and clean,
But after all that jelly beans, they're looking rather green!
The sugar bugs are having a party in your mouth,
They're building little castles and they're dancing round and round!
They're chewing on your enamel, they're making holes so deep,
And soon you'll have a toothache that will make you want to weep!
The dentist will come with a drill that goes *whirrrrr* and *zzzzzz*,
And say, "No more donuts for you, my friend, until you're better, I guess!"

SECTION 3
SECTION 3
You feel so full of candy, you can't move your legs or arms,
You're stuck inside your pajamas, you're covered in sweet charms!
Your brain is fuzzy, like a cloud, you can't remember your name,
You tried to tie your shoelaces, but you tied them in a flame!
You're sleepy as a sloth, but your heart is beating fast,
You're running in a circle, but you're moving way too slow, it's a blast!
You want to eat a cookie, but you're too full to chew,
You're a sticky, sugary mess, and you don't know what to do!

SECTION 4
SECTION 4
So listen to the lesson, before you eat the whole jar,
Too many sweets will make you feel like a wobbly, wacky star!
Eat an apple, eat a carrot, they make you strong and tall,
They give you energy to run and jump and play ball!
Save the candy for a special day, a tiny little bite,
So your tummy stays happy and your teeth stay shining bright!
No more sugar crashes, no more sticky, gooey hands,
Just healthy, happy kids who are the best in all the lands!
